Messages.Body:
Date: Saturday, January 25th, 2025
Registration: 10:30
First round starting time: 11:00
Expected finishing time: 20:00

Type of Event: Standard Constructed

Proxy cards are allowed. See the instructions for the use of proxies and of cards from printable V:EKN expansion sets in sections 4.5 and 4.1 of the  tournament rules .

Number of rounds: 3 + final
Time limit per round: 2 hours

Address of Event:
Troll2Jeux 15-17 Place d'Aligre, 75012 Paris
troll2jeux.com/

Entry fee: 13€

*** Pre-registration ***

Pre-registration is very useful to ensure appropriate prize support and a timely start of the tournament. If you intend to participate, please sign up as soon as possible by replying to this thread (with your name and VEKN number). You can also go the the French forum for live details: www.vekn.fr/forum/viewtopic.php?t=20107

*** How to reach ***

The shop is at 9 minutes by foot from the train station Gare de Lyon (and not far from other metro stations).

Gare de Lyon is at 15 minutes from Gare du Nord (using RER D or RER B+A with a change at Châtelet) for those who would come from Belgium, Netherlands, or even London!

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director
